description: Fetch any Banco Central do Brasil SGS time series by numeric code. Common codes: 432=Selic target, 11=Selic daily, 433=IPCA inflation, 1=USD/BRL PTAX sell, 21619=USD/BRL, 4389=CDI. Returns {series_code, series_name, country:"Brazil", statement, count, observations:[{data:"dd/MM/yyyy", valor:"..."}]}. Use "last" for the most recent N observations, or a date range.

last.description: Return only the most recent N observations, e.g. 12. Omit for full/ranged series.

name: sgs_series
title: Sgs Series
